headline: Fed holds steady as markets surge; megacap earnings and rate path next focus

eventsToday.event: Fed Holds Rates Steady with Three Dissents for Increase

bullets.title: Fed Freeze Holds Despite Dissent
bullets.body: Fed held rates at 3.63% with three officials voting for increase; signals hawkish patience.

bullets.title: Risk-On Rally Crushes Volatility
bullets.body: SPY +1.68%, QQQ +3.30%; VIX collapsed 17.28% to 17.09. Put sellers benefit from compression.

bullets.title: Yields Spike to 19-Year Highs
bullets.body: 10Y yield +89bps to 4.663%; US borrowing costs near 2-decade peaks despite Fed hold.

bullets.title: Tech Bifurcation: Semis Soar, Mega-Cap Split
bullets.body: MSFT +15.51%, NVDA +2.65%; AAPL -1.41%, META -7.95%. Semiconductor rotation strengthens.

bullets.title: Semiconductor Strength Extends
bullets.body: MRVL +12.18%, POET +14.29%, INTC +11.30%. Chip sector lead continues amid AI narrative.

bullets.title: Megacap Earnings Week Ahead
bullets.body: Major earnings and Fed communications could test edge; earnings surge pressures valuations.

bullets.title: Breadth Broadens Above 50-DMA
bullets.body: Most S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA for first time since February—strength verified by breadth.
